notes: HELD: massing is exact (3DBAG) but detail is generic. Not modelled: the white-stone pilaster bays, dormers and the central gable of the Amstel front, the glazed terrace, turret oriel; window rows are an even rhythm rather than the real bay spacing. The NE side (35 m, bearing 58) is a genuine party wall with the neighbouring panden and is exempted in the audit via partyWallBearings.
